## Specific task description

Task instruction: Take the lightweight round tabletop trashbin and empty it.

Task description: The target is the light-colored round mini trash can with an open top at the front right of the current table. Pour the red balls inside it into the large trash can on the left side of the table.

Success criteria: All five red balls leave the small bin and fall to a low position near the bottom of the large bin on the left. The small bin remains held high, with its body clearly above the table. Merely tilting it while balls remain inside is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the small bin's upper wall facing the robot, with one finger inside and one outside. Open slightly wider than local thickness and contact below the rim with the pads to reduce slippage from holding only the thin edge.
- Before closing, confirm that the two fingers are on the inside and outside of the same section of bucket wall. The inner finger need only enter shallowly; avoid hitting the balls at the bottom or blocking the pouring path.
- Keep the container opening facing upward during transport and use the open area in the middle of the table to leave room for the container and gripper to move. Avoid hitting bottles or toys behind it and spilling the balls prematurely.
- If a handoff is needed, let the other gripper hold a different section of the bin wall and confirm it is supporting the bin before releasing the original gripper, avoiding a tip-over while the lightweight bin is suspended.
- When pouring, move the discharge-side bucket rim beyond the large bin's inner edge and rotate slowly toward its interior. If balls remain, make small oscillations with the opening down and allow time to fall, avoiding rim collisions or flinging balls out.
